pages.title: Potion of Bogrot
pages.text: Begin with an Awkward Potion, brewed normally by adding Nether Wart to Water Bottles.$(br2)Add $(item)Bog Toad Venom$() to the Awkward Potion to brew a $(thing)Potion of Bogrot$(). Venom does not work directly on Water Bottles or unrelated potions.

pages.title: The Primary Brew
pages.text: $(item)Awkward Potion$() + $(item)Bog Toad Venom$()$(br)→ $(thing)Potion of Bogrot$()$(br2)This is the only primary recipe for Bogrot.

pages.title: Bottle Conversions
pages.text: Once Bogrot has been brewed, vanilla bottle conversions apply:$(br2)$(thing)Potion of Bogrot$() + $(item)Gunpowder$()$(br)→ $(thing)Splash Potion of Bogrot$()$(br2)$(thing)Splash Potion of Bogrot$() + $(item)Dragon's Breath$()$(br)→ $(thing)Lingering Potion of Bogrot$()$(br2)These ingredients convert an existing Bogrot potion; they do not brew the base potion.
